phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.justification: directed transformation that advances the chain through successive braid crossings

AREV.justification: reverse descent that unwinds a braid crossing to test an alternate fold path

CLINK.justification: sequential composition of adjacent residue braids into a single folding morphism

ENGAGR.justification: both native contact and steric clash held simultaneously across the anyon channel

EVALF.justification: negative state where two residues occupy incompatible volume

EVALT.justification: affirmative state where a residue pair achieves its native contact

FFUSE.justification: the braid arm and direct arm rejoin into one resolved basin state

FSPLIT.justification: one dyadic state opens into two arms: the braid channel and the direct fold path

IFIX.justification: permanent append-only record of every braid decision that cannot be undone

IMSCRIB.justification: self-reference where a residue braids with itself and remains unchanged

TANCH.justification: the closed terminal boundary that contains the completed fold

VINIT.justification: the void state before any residue braid or channel operation is named

phase_2.rejoin_note: the braid arm applies Fibonacci anyon crossings while the relaxation arm settles the dyad directly; the arms rejoin into one state, and the fork closes
phase_2.split_input: one residue pair in an unfolded conformation
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held at once: a live contradiction, the paraconsistent resolution
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: uninitialized, nothing established

steps.domain_action: unfolded polypeptide chain with no braid operations applied
